thread:
Anita: Heads-up — eu-west dedicated pool "dedicated-eu2-small" showing a sustained tail latency spike and a cluster of early evictions over the last hour. Net telemetry shows intermittent egress microbursts.
Leo: Any obvious noisy tenant on that pool?
Anita: Looks correlated with tenant @viz-ops — long-context streaming + heavy KV regen. kvcache_miss and io_wait spike together. Sample from kube logs: ```2026-03-21T09:02:11Z pod=d-123 node=eu2-03 evict=1 reason=egress_burst kvcache_miss=342 tail_p99_ms=420```
Maya: :thinking_face: Did the eviction gate fire or was this normal slice-level preempt?
Anita: Eviction was at slice level (soft), which ends up draining and spilling into adjacent slices -> amplifies egress.
Oliver: We recently added hierarchical pool plumbing; thinking the problem is rules are only at slice granularity. Proposal: add an eviction gate at pool->slice boundary that checks combined egress rate + kvcache_miss before escalating to slice eviction.
Leo: So a pool-level dampener that blocks over-eager slice evictions?
Oliver: Exactly. Short-circuits preempt unless both: (a) node-level cpu/mem > threshold OR (b) sustained egress above X for Ys AND kvcache_miss>Z. Keeps noisy streams from causing collateral.
Anita: Draft config snippet: ```# feature: hierarchical_eviction_gate
enabled: true
pool_level_check:
  egress_bps_threshold: 50mbps
  sustained_secs: 30
  kvcache_miss_threshold: 100
  action: throttle_or_mark_noisy
slice_escalation: only_if_pool_gate_passes
```
Kai: Where does that decision live today? scheduler or proxy?
Oliver: Scheduler decision pipeline. Minimal change: add a pre-evict hook that queries aggregate pool telemetry. ~10 LOC in the evict decisioner.
Kai: I'm +1 but want a quick cost estimate — noisy tenants here are burning reserved capacity and forcing extra backfills (cost).
Oliver: Back-of-envelope: this tenant increased tail tokens ~12% on 40 nodes for 6 hours yesterday -> ~2.3M extra tokens/day in eu-west dedicated fleet ~ ~$5k/week at current unit cost. If gate reduces spill/evictions we should recoup ~25-35% of that.
Maya: Alternatively we could try a soft carveout: fractional slice assigned to long-context heavy runs so they don't thrash KV across slices. Less invasive but requires routing tweak.
Anita: Test plan I suggest: feature-flag the gate, deploy as canary to 10 nodes in eu-west1-b for 24h with traffic-split 5% routing to the gated decisioner. Monitor: p99_token_latency, kvcache_miss_rate, slice_eviction_count, egress_bps, and allocation_spillovers. If no regress, promote to 50% then 100%.
sre-bot: Deploy queued: hierarchical-evict-gate v0.1 -> canary(10 nodes) by @oliver. Runbook: watch p99/p95 and eviction_count dashboards for 2h post-deploy.
Kai: I'll draft a short cost impact note and ping Sales for potential billing outreach to @viz-ops. @oliver @anita can we sync on rollout window? :thumbsup:
